مُرَنَّحٌ Swooning, or fainting; or affected by a weakness of the bones, (S, L, K,) and of the body; by reason of beating or fright or intoxication, and sometimes by reason of anxiety, and grief, or sorrow; (L;) and inclining from side to side. (S, L, K.) ＝
-A2- Also, (A, K,) or ↓ مُرْنَحٌ , (so in the L,) (tropical:) Aloes-wood, (A, L, K,) of the best kind, (L, K,) used for fumigation. (A, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
